notes.sowing: Sow {cm:0.6} deep from 4 weeks before your last frost, or start indoors 4 to 6 weeks ahead and plant out around the last frost. Seed germinates poorly in soil above {c:27}, so sow summer batches in shade or in the evening.
notes.care: Keep the soil evenly moist, as the shallow roots dry out fast. Several days above {c:24} bring on bolting and bitterness, so give light shade in warm spells and sow little and often, about every 2 weeks.
notes.harvest: Pick outer leaves once they are about {cm:10} long, or cut whole heads leaving a {cm:2.5} stump to regrow. For a fall crop, sow 8 to 12 weeks before your first fall frost.
